limitations.quote: // The final zero can also start the next sequence.
limitations.note: The patch fixed the one-cycle delay in `match` but also changed the transitions out of `s4_d0110` to allow overlapping matches, including across invalid cycles, whereas the reference fix preserves those transitions.
The test oracle assumed every overlapping occurrence should match, so it rewarded the unintended transition changes instead of checking that the original post-match behavior was preserved.
